scope.narrative_review: All article openings and manifest hero captions/alt inspected; targeted full narrative/section inspection for flagged visual contexts. Not a new complete factual audit of every paragraph.
scope.documentation: Human Natural cultural collection review; current second-pass scope; manifest and referenced provenance availability checked. No new web research or identity inference from face alone.

verdict: No confirmed image/story factual mismatch or invented documentary label found in this bounded pass. Four narrow representational/style findings; no blanket cultural-authenticity certification.

findings.visible: Hands sew folded sheets into a book; no identifiable face.
findings.evidence: Narrative Making books as well as writing them establishes a publishing partnership, not the author personally hand-binding volumes. Current caption is generic and already says Illustration.
findings.recommendation: Keep the image as a publishing metaphor. If revising the caption, use An imagined bookbinding scene: one part of bringing books to readers. Do not describe these as Basanta’s own hands or her documented binding practice. No factual correction to biography required.
findings.confidence: high on visible action and evidence boundary; medium on reader confusion

findings.visible: Anonymous actors seen from behind or oblique views occupy realistic rehearsal and script-discussion scenes.
findings.evidence: Both retained provenance records explicitly exclude the named person’s likeness or a documented event. Current captions say Illustration, which substantially mitigates confusion.
findings.recommendation: Preserve generic alt text and, if captions are tightened, add imagined rehearsal/script discussion. Do not turn the anonymous figures into named portraits, Bou Buttu Bhuta set evidence or exact recalled meetings. No asset replacement necessary solely because the page is biographical.

findings.visible: Warm wooden tables, window light, blank or softly indicated pages and quiet working gestures recur.
findings.evidence: Different original files and different scenes; no cross-article identical original hash. Similar visual grammar is not duplicate use.
findings.recommendation: Do not bulk-regenerate approved assets. For future replacements, vary viewpoint, time of day and concrete activity rather than default to another warmly lit desk. Retain the genuinely distinct photographs and archive sheets.
findings.confidence: high aesthetic observation; editorial judgment not factual defect

findings.visible: A small signature-like dark squiggle sits at the lower-left edge of the painted drum image.
findings.evidence: Observed on full-size original; not an identified artist’s signature and not a readable attribution. The actual caption calls this an illustration.
findings.recommendation: If this illustration is otherwise revised, remove the decorative signature-like mark rather than implying a hand-signed historical artwork. Do not invent an artist credit from the mark. This is not a proven rights violation or a release blocker.
findings.confidence: high visible mark; low semantic meaning

positive_checks: Active Learning Cinema Together image shows paper script discussion, no laptop; stale laptop version is not the active manifest asset.
All56 current originals match manifest hashes; no exact-hash cross-article original duplication.
All six active line-art motifs are distinct and tied to a book/screen, cataloguing, collaboration, threshold, publicity or waiting passage.

Current documentary portrait/event captions retain named contexts rather than describing historical film stills. Stamp and novel sheet remain documentary objects, not ordinary photographs or film posters.
DAMaN current hero shows colleagues packing plain boxes and mosquito netting; no asserted real ASHA uniform, identifiable doctor or reproduced programme event.
Bhukha is illustrated by a generic drum; no claim that this is the exact instrument or setting seen in the film.
Pramod’s hand/cube/cutout/camera scene supports material experimentation. Camera is not identified as Pati’s actual equipment; no technical model/date authenticity claim.
Maya and Pratikshya hero settings are explicitly imagined, distinct from the newly observed film/trailer passages. Do not relabel them as frames from those passages.

limitations: Contact sheets are triage, not pixel-by-pixel inspection of every original. Eight selected originals were inspected at full size.
Retained licence/source records were reused; this is not renewed rights-owner verification or proof of uploader ownership.
No face-recognition identity conclusions, specialist instrument taxonomy, historical-equipment certification or universal costume validation.
Exact duplicate hashes plus visual triage do not exhaust every possible transformed-source similarity.
No generated artwork, asset alterations, canonical edits, browser inspection or publication.
